name.value: The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm

description.value: The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm is a 1,400 sq ft, three-bedroom vacation cabin on a functioning 7-acre permaculture homestead near Mount Currie, sleeping up to six guests. The property features a private hydrotherapy suite with hot tub, cold plunge, and cedar barrel sauna, plus unobstructed views of Mount Currie (t'szil). Owners Gus and Jocelyn live 150 metres from the cabin and offer guided farm tours so guests can meet resident donkeys, Highland cattle, and milk cows.

raw_osm.description: Boutique Bed and Breakfast situated on a secluded 7 acre homestead farm.
raw_osm.name: Sweetwater Lane Farm B&B

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the property is an active, self-contained cabin rental on a 7-acre farm near Mount Currie; laundry and Wi-Fi are explicitly listed in the amenities section. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or cycling-specific services appears anywhere on the site. Three notable data discrepancies exist: the website phone (+1 604 966 4396) differs from OSM (+1-604-698-6911), the website branding is 'The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm' not 'B&B', and the map page lists the address as 1939 Sweetwater Ln vs. OSM's 1937.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM has +1-604-698-6911 but the website consistently shows +1 604 966 4396 across all pages; website value used in top-level phone field.
Business name mismatch: OSM uses 'Sweetwater Lane Farm B&B' but the website brand is 'The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm' with no reference to B&B.
Street number discrepancy: OSM lists 1937 Sweetwater Lane but the website map page shows 1939 Sweetwater Ln.
No breakfast is mentioned anywhere on the website despite 'B&B' in the OSM name; the property operates as a self-contained cabin rental.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active accommodation in a cycling-relevant area near Pemberton and Joffre Lakes, but no bike storage or cycling-specific services are documented on the website. Multiple contact discrepancies (phone number, street number, business name) also warrant manual verification before listing.

Laundry.detail: Website states 'Full laundry with dryer facilities' in the cabin description; overview amenities also list 'Iron & Board'
